title: 019 şeridi toplayıcı (r2): kanıt bağlama sonrası
summary: 114'ün üstüne ci.yml'in 115 ile değişen hâlini de kapsar; diğer dört hassas dosya (db.py, worker.py, ai_sdlc_check.py ve testi) değişmedi.

evaluation.exact_command: apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q scripts/test_ai_sdlc_check.py && cd apps/api && TEST_DB_NAME=dou_r3 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_rls_session_context.py tests/test_worker_graceful_shutdown.py tests/test_token_quota_multiprocess.py && cd apps/api && .venv/bin/mypy app && apps/api/.venv/bin/python scripts/workflow_policy_check.py && supabase/tests/rls_learning_events_mutation_check.sh rls_learning_template_019 && supabase/tests/rls_storage_mutation_check.sh dou_l5_storage_ci019 && bash scripts/test_backup_restore_drill.sh

deployment.feature_flag: required-check:AI quality / Govern reviewed AI diff

rollout.feature_flag: required-check:AI quality / Govern reviewed AI diff
rollout.kill_switch: Repository administrator documents an emergency exception before temporarily removing the required check.
rollout.assignment: Sticky per pull-request head SHA; reruns inspect the same reviewed commit.
rollout.initial_exposure: All pull requests after branch-protection activation.
stop_conditions: The gate exposes secret or student content.
The gate accepts an uncovered AI-sensitive diff.
The gate validates a commit other than the reviewed pull-request head.
expand_conditions: Mutation suite remains green in CI.
Required reviewers accept the policy and workflow.
rollout.active_exam_policy: No runtime or active-exam behaviour changes; this is a repository control.

rollback.procedure: Disable the required AI-quality check if active, revert this governance change, and rerun the pre-existing core CI gates.
rollback.verification: Confirm core CI still runs and no AI-quality check is reported as required after the documented rollback.

privacy.handling: Only synthetic fixture identities, repository paths, hashes and stable error codes are recorded.
privacy.retention: Versioned with the repository; no raw prompts, secrets, student answers or provider payloads.
